abstract: Gene model for the ortholog of supernumerary limbs (slmb) in the Apr. 2013 (BCM-HGSC Dpse_3.0/DpseGB3) Genome Assembly (GenBank Accession: GCA_000001765.2) of Drosophila pseudoobscura. This ortholog was characterized as part of a developing dataset to study the evolution of the Insulin/insulin-like growth factor signaling pathway (IIS) across the genus Drosophila using the Genomics Education Partnership gene annotation protocol for Course-based Undergraduate Research Experiences.
